premise: Acorn wishes on the brightest star for a friend to stay up with her; the star floats down and it is Firefly.
inspiration: The star-wishing motif of folk tales, turned: the wonder is not magic but a friend who heard.
lesson: Sometimes a wish comes true because a friend is listening.

en-US.title: Acorn Wishes on a Star
en-US.text: {sfx:crickets} {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] It was bedtime, and the sky was full of stars. {acorn:enter} Acorn {acorn:pulse} couldn't sleep. {owl:enter} Owl came flying down onto a branch. {owl:live} He blinked, looked around, gave a big yawn and nodded off… then opened one eye, then both. Hoo? [whispers] Owl, do stars grant wishes? asked Acorn. {owl:face happy} Some say so. Pick the brightest one. There! {firefly:enter} One little star, low and twinkling just above the grass. [curious] Acorn {acorn:live hold} clasped her hands, closed her eyes tight, and wished for a friend to stay up with her. And the little star {firefly:float loop 0.3} {firefly:go to acorn} came floating down, closer and closer. {acorn:live resume} Acorn opened her eyes and threw up her arms. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] It was Firefly! {firefly:live} She closed her eyes and glowed brighter and brighter, like a little lantern… then blinked twice, smiling. {firefly:face happy} I heard you! {acorn:face happy} [happily] So they made wishes together, {acorn:hearts} and {owl:pulse} Owl kept watch until Acorn was {acorn:face sleeping} fast asleep.

es-ES.title: Bellota pide un deseo
es-ES.text: {sfx:crickets} {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] Era hora de dormir, y el cielo estaba lleno de estrellas. {acorn:enter} Bellota {acorn:pulse} no podía dormirse. {owl:enter} Búho bajó volando a una rama. {owl:live} Parpadeó, miró a su alrededor, bostezó y se quedó dormido… luego abrió un ojo, y después los dos. ¿Uh? [whispers] Búho, ¿las estrellas conceden deseos?, preguntó Bellota. {owl:face happy} Eso dicen. Elige la que más brille. ¡Allí! {firefly:enter} Una estrellita bajita, brillando justo encima de la hierba. [curious] Bellota {acorn:live hold} juntó las manitas, cerró los ojos con fuerza y pidió una amiga que se quedara despierta con ella. Y la estrellita {firefly:float loop 0.3} {firefly:go to acorn} bajó flotando, cada vez más cerca. {acorn:live resume} Bellota abrió los ojos y levantó los brazos. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Era Luciérnaga! {firefly:live} Cerró los ojos y brilló más y más, como un farolillo… y luego parpadeó dos veces, sonriendo. {firefly:face happy} ¡Te he oído! {acorn:face happy} [happily] Así que pidieron deseos juntas, {acorn:hearts} y {owl:pulse} Búho vigiló hasta que Bellota {acorn:face sleeping} se quedó dormida.

crickets.prompt: quiet night crickets in a summer meadow, very soft
